storyboards.title: Quiet Walk
storyboards.summary: Observational and unhurried. The camera stays beside her at a polite distance and lets the end of a shift settle on its own. The ice cream is ordinary, not a prop.

shots.purpose: Establish that the working day is over and the walk has already begun.
shots.description: Medium wide of Harim walking left to right along a seafront promenade in a navy wool coat, holding a single-scoop cone at waist height, sea and low sun behind her.

sample_request.raw_user_prompt: Harim finishes her shift and walks by the sea eating ice cream.

scene_spec.location: seafront promenade beside a low sea wall, late afternoon
scene_spec.activity: walking at an unhurried pace while holding a single-scoop ice cream cone
scene_spec.camera: medium wide, eye level, tracking parallel with the subject
scene_spec.lighting: low warm sun from behind with a soft rim along the coat shoulder

shots.purpose: Hold on the moment the day stops mattering.
shots.description: Medium close-up from the side as Harim pauses at the sea wall, eats without hurry and looks out past the camera, coat collar catching the last light.

continuity.props: single-scoop ice cream cone, partly eaten

sample_request.raw_user_prompt: Harim finishes her shift and walks by the sea eating ice cream.

scene_spec.location: at a low sea wall on the promenade, late afternoon
scene_spec.activity: pausing at the wall and eating slowly while looking out to sea
scene_spec.lighting: low warm sun raking across the face from screen right

storyboards.title: Last Light
storyboards.summary: Warmer and tighter. The sun is nearly gone and the walk is read through what the light does to her rather than through the geography of the promenade.

shots.purpose: Open inside the feeling instead of the location.
shots.description: Close-up of the cone and one bare hand against the navy coat, sea bokeh behind, sun almost down.

sample_request.raw_user_prompt: Harim finishes her shift and walks by the sea eating ice cream.

scene_spec.activity: holding an ice cream cone close to the chest while walking
scene_spec.camera: close-up on the hand and cone with the face soft in the upper frame
scene_spec.lighting: warm low sun flaring from screen left

shots.purpose: Widen out once the feeling has landed.
shots.description: Wide of a small figure in a navy coat far along the empty promenade, sea filling most of the frame, last band of orange on the horizon.

sample_request.raw_user_prompt: Harim finishes her shift and walks by the sea eating ice cream.

scene_spec.location: long empty seafront promenade at sunset
scene_spec.activity: walking away from camera along the promenade
scene_spec.camera: wide, static, subject small in frame
scene_spec.lighting: last band of orange on the horizon, cool blue elsewhere

storyboards.title: One Frame
storyboards.summary: A single image that has to carry the whole idea. Cheapest to produce and the right choice if the run is really about identity and wardrobe rather than sequence.

shots.purpose: Say end-of-shift, sea, and ice cream in one readable frame.
shots.description: Three-quarter medium shot of Harim on the promenade mid-step with the cone raised, sea wall and water behind, work bag still on her shoulder.

continuity.props: single-scoop ice cream cone, shoulder bag

sample_request.raw_user_prompt: Harim finishes her shift and walks by the sea eating ice cream.

scene_spec.location: seafront promenade with a low sea wall and open water behind
scene_spec.activity: mid-step with the ice cream cone raised, shoulder bag still worn
scene_spec.props: single-scoop ice cream cone and a plain shoulder bag
scene_spec.lighting: soft late-afternoon daylight, no hard shadow on the face
